study.question: Does the preliminary utility of supplied history order arise through ten-event compression/grouping, through the five explicit moment summaries, or through their interaction, conditional on complete event content and the frozen incumbent training rule?
study.hypothesis: The supplied-order advantage is carried primarily by explicit moment summaries. Replacing supplied order only in compression with exact complete-event canonical order will preserve most click AUC, whereas replacing order in the five summaries will lose more. This is a discriminating provisional hypothesis, not an inference already established by the prior joint intervention. Every removed-order path receives all events, item fields, actions and task memberships with unchanged padding; the other path is untouched.

nearest_work.difference: Nearest local architecture is retained, including action-aware DIN activation, ten-event compression, five match/position summaries, context/history product corrections and the surrogate context VJP. Only the input order seen by two internal paths is factored.

Reuses exact complete-event lexicographic ordering but decouples summary and compression views. Embeddings are evaluated once before gathering rather than after global input sorting; new simultaneous corner controls check this implementation bridge.

Archived primary text lines249-283 verifies target-dependent unnormalized pooling and reports an external unsuccessful LSTM attempt. This study is a four-task adapted local model attribution, not a DIN reproduction, a new sequence architecture or evidence that the external LSTM result transfers.

Pinned benchmark forward lines175-200 flattens history before unified tokenization. We retain existing modules and isolate order paths rather than introduce flattening/token mixing. Original UniMixer paper equivalence and priority are unverified.

study.proposed_difference: Introduce pooling_view and moment_view in {supplied,canonical}. Build the canonical bijection using every supplied item/action field plus four historical task masks, sorting only within valid positions. Gather raw IDs and embedded values into the moment view; gather values and the event-associated auxiliary union into the pooling view. Transport target-match membership back through the inverse moment bijection then forward through the pooling bijection. No learned modules, buffers, loss changes or new random stream are introduced. Run all four corners contemporaneously; retain the prior shuffle and eval-only trajectories as contextual evidence.
predictions: Write A_PM for click AUC with pooling view P and moment view M, where S=supplied and C=canonical. Predict A_SS-A_SC exceeds A_SS-A_CS: removing supplied-order moments hurts more than removing supplied-order compression.
If summaries suffice, A_CS is within a prespecified practical margin 0.0005 of A_SS and A_SC is materially lower; this is a quality tolerance, not a statistical equivalence test.

Simple moment effects are A_SS-A_SC and A_CS-A_CC; simple pooling effects are A_SS-A_CS and A_SC-A_CC. The interaction is A_SS-A_SC-A_CS+A_CC. Do not attribute a main effect alone if the interaction is consequential.

SS should reproduce the prior supplied corner at fixed weights; CC should reproduce the prior canonical corner at fixed weights up to declared floating-point tolerance. Retrained bridge drift must be reported rather than silently borrowing old metrics.

The CC predictor should be invariant at a fixed state to joint valid-event permutations, including membership-only tie cases. Mixed arms should preserve the native summaries or native compression exactly at a fixed state as appropriate. Empty/single event treatments cannot create information.
Learned parameter count remains 32192421. Sorting and gathering increase measured cost relative to the old supplied incumbent; equal quality need not imply equal efficiency.
falsifiers: A_SS-A_CS is consistently larger than A_SS-A_SC under paired repetitions, or A_CS fails to retain practical quality while A_SC does; this rejects the proposed summary-dominance explanation.
Neither simple moment effect is reproducibly positive after effective event reorder and successful gates; no evidence supports useful supplied order specifically through summaries.

No reproducible A_SS advantage over an effective invariant A_CC after matched retraining weakens supplied-order utility for this replacement and frozen protocol; it does not prove no better sequence model exists.
Failed bijection, event/mask association, padding, target, gradient-transport or CC invariance gates invalidate attribution regardless of AUC. Missing diagnostics leave mechanism support unverified.
A material interaction or systematic bridge mismatch prevents the clean one-path explanation and requires a charged discriminating follow-up rather than mechanism confirmation.
alternative_explanations: Canonical ranks use arbitrary encoded-ID ordering and are a specific invariant replacement, not an optimal unordered learner.
Changing a path also changes its normalization populations, match centering/support gates and optimization trajectory.
Inherited batch-coupled surrogate VJP may mediate order effects; conclusions are conditional on that training rule.
Only one host seed is initially authorized; repeated same-seed bridges are implementation checks, not independent repetitions.
Prior eval-only loss can reflect distribution shift; matched retraining contrasts are primary.
Prior training-shuffle gap can reflect stochastic augmentation and optimization in addition to information removal.
Order effects can be mediated by content grouping, summary scale or Dice statistics, without learned temporal dependencies.
No timestamps are supplied: supplied positions do not identify elapsed time, and offline delayed feedback is an inherited benchmark limitation.
Within-run empty-history score changes after retraining can arise from global parameter updates and are not evidence that an empty sequence has order.

evidence_review.interpretation: All supplied receipts succeeded computationally; the shuffle/canonical candidates lost click AUC. These negative predictive trajectories are not execution failures. No independent seed repetition or successful mechanism diagnostic is present. The identical incumbent/supplied AUC is a same-seed reproduction. Full-shuffle loss0.003075735 and canonical loss0.004572591 motivate path localization; eval-only loss0.003893404 is sensitivity evidence. Auxiliary mean AUC improves slightly under shuffled retraining while click AUC declines, so auxiliary mean must not select the model.
evidence_review.remaining_uncertainty: Existing interventions jointly changed compression grouping, moment features, support gates and training distributions. They do not identify the useful path or confirm temporal semantics.
